d:
Presenting "Jaavedaan Hai Ishq Tujhse" video song from the Bollywood movie 1920 Evil Returns. Vikram Bhatt is back with his horror flick "1920 Evil Returns" a sequel to his earlier movie 1920. His all movies have fabulous music and as expected "1920 Evil Returns" also has astounding music.
Enjoy this full video song in melodious voice of KK, Suzanne D'Mello and stay connected with us!!
Song: Jaavedaan Hai Ishq Tujhse
Singer: KK, Suzanne D'Mello
Lyrics: Shakeel Azmi
Music Director: Chirantan Bhatt
Music Label: T-Series
